changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS public.retail_user_region_assignment_id_seq INCREMENT BY 1 NO MINVALUE NO MAXVALUE START WITH 1 CACHE 1; CREATE TABLE public.retail_user_region_assignment ( id bigint DEFAULT nextval('public.retail_user_region_assignment_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL, tenant_id character varying(255) NOT NULL, user_profile_id bigint NOT NULL, region character varying(255) NOT NULL, assigned_by_user_profile_id bigint, notes character varying(500), created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT retail_user_region_assignment_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ux_retail_user_region_assignment__tenant_user_region UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_profile_id, region), CONSTRAINT fk_retail_user_region_assignment__tenant_id FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES public.tenant_organization(tenant_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_retail_user_region_assignment__user_profile FOREIGN KEY (user_profile_id) REFERENCES public.user_profile(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_retail_user_region_assignment__assigned_by FOREIGN KEY (assigned_by_user_profile_id) REFERENCES public.user_profile(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ); CREATE INDEX idx_retail_user_region_assignment_tenant_user ON public.retail_user_region_assignment (tenant_id, user_profile_id); COMMENT ON TABLE public.retail_user_region_assignment IS 'Regions a RETAIL_REGIONAL_MANAGER may see. A store is included when retail_location.region matches. A blank region on a store is not included.';
